content:
Apple Arcade just added new games last week, but today another title has debuted, and several more have been announced for release soon. Here are the details.

Apple Arcade adding new titles in Prince of Persia, Plants vs. Zombies, and Football Touch franchises, plus new twist on solitaire from Balatro publisher

Apple Arcade has a new game launching today: Football Manager 27 Touch.

The latest entry in the popular Football Manager franchise arrives today as an update to the existing app. Here’s what’s new per Apple Newsroom:

An elevated Match Engine offers ways to shape the action on the pitch, new Recruitment and Match Preparation tools make scouting and game plans easier to master, and a redesigned iPhone interface keeps everything within thumb’s reach.

Apple has also announced several new games coming to Arcade on December 3.

The first two arrive for franchises that should be recognizable to most gamers. But solitaire(ish) is also well worth your attention. It’s from Playstack, publisher of the indie hit Balatro, and Apple says it offers “a roguelike twist” on solitaire.

Are you interested in these Arcade titles? How often do you play Apple Arcade games? Let us know in the comments.

Apple Arcade is available for $6.99/month or through the Apple One bundle. It includes unlimited access to 200+ quality games with no ads or in-app purchases.
